title: Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet) (lesson 9)
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y1 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet (draw and tick; printable or for a drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 9: Staying calm and standing up for myself, online too. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Calm first
points: Say 'A'udhu billah' if you feel angry

keywords.def: doing the right thing even when it is hard
a word that means I do not agree

questions.q: Practise: say 'Stop, I don't like that' in a calm, firm voice.
questions.a: Children say it clearly with a calm face.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: draw a traffic light; next to red write 'stop', amber 'say no', green 'tell'.
questions.a: A traffic light with the three steps.

questions.q: Extend: name two trusted adults, one at home and one at TGA.
questions.a: For example: Dad and my class teacher.

questions.q: A game online asks for your home address. What do you do?
questions.a: A) Stop and tell a grown-up. Never share personal information; stop and tell.

questions.q: If something online feels wrong we ...
Think again: Someone keeps taking your pencil. What could you say that is kind but firm?
questions.a: 'Please stop, I don't like that. Please give it back.' If it keeps happening, tell an adult.
